item.title: Art Is Trash – Ephemeral Street Art from Barcelona
item.description: Art Is Trash is the street-art identity of Francisco de Pájaro, an artist from Zafra in Extremadura who lives and works in Barcelona. His internationally exhibited practice transforms discarded cardboard, furniture, rubbish bags and other abandoned materials into politically charged, ephemeral street-art sculptures with exceptional expressive force.

item.title: Ashwan – Hip-Hop, Lettering and Contemporary Urban Art
item.description: Ashwan is a Barcelona-based contemporary artist whose work connects hip-hop culture, graffiti influences, lettering and mixed media. His practice frequently transforms discarded cardboard and everyday materials into layered artworks that move between urban culture and contemporary art.

item.title: Si Beriana – Colorful Figurative Street Art in Barcelona
item.description: Si Beriana creates colorful figurative street art and murals connected with Barcelona's contemporary urban-art scene. Her work combines expressive characters, strong outlines and vibrant color with the architecture and visual energy of public space.

item.title: Peeta – Sculpting Urban Space Through Optical Illusion
item.description: Peeta, the artist name of Manuel Di Rita, is an Italian urban artist internationally known for three-dimensional lettering, geometric compositions and anamorphic murals. Active in graffiti since the early 1990s, his work has evolved from traditional lettering into a distinctive visual language combining painting, sculpture, architecture and optical illusion. Peeta often incorporates windows, corners and structural elements of buildings into his compositions, making walls appear to bend, expand or break apart. His work transforms architecture into an active part of the artwork and represents a striking evolution of contemporary graffiti and urban art.

item.title: El Rughi – Italian Psychedelic Graffiti Artist Based in Barcelona
item.description: El Rughi is a self-taught Italian urban artist born in 1989 in Martina Franca, Apulia, and now based in Barcelona. His visual language combines classic graffiti, underground comics, psychedelic culture, children's illustration, tattoo influences and contemporary graphics.

item.title: Darel Carey – Optical Art, Murals and Immersive Lines from Los Angeles
item.description: Darel Carey is a Los Angeles-based visual artist born in Curaçao and raised in Colton, California. His practice focuses on optical and spatial perception through dimensional line drawings, murals, immersive tape installations, paintings and digital art.

item.title: JEKS – Hyperrealistic Murals in Ontario, California
item.description: JEKS is the artist name of Brian Lewis, a self-taught graffiti artist and muralist from Greensboro, North Carolina. He is internationally recognised for large-format hyperrealistic portraits created with aerosol paint. Urban Arts News presents selected works connected with Ontario, California and its public mural scene.
